Yes. In the v2 snapshot, `threading.Thread` accepts `context`, and its default is `None`.

The `library/threading.rst` signature reads `Thread(group=None, target=None, name=None, args=(), kwargs={}, *, daemon=None, context=None)`. The same file has a version note saying "Added the *context* parameter" in 3.14. An earlier conversation answer said `context` was not accepted, but that was based on the older signature without it, so I did not rely on it.

```json
{"facts": {"available": "true", "default": "None"}}
```
